tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i lung sbyor bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems
(da)༄༅/ /byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i lung sbyor bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i lung sbyor bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal nas// skabs su bab pa'i lung sbyor rnams// mdo tsam 'dir ni bri bar bya// byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brten pa dang brten byung ba// gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed 'dod// ces pa dang*/ chos bcu pa'i mdo'i don/ bslab btus las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am de'i nyan thos kyis bskul ba las sems bskyed pa 'di ni/ byang chub kyi sems la mos pa'i rgyu dang po'o// bsngags pa thos nas sems bskyed pa ni rgyu gnyis pa'o// sems can gyi sdug bsngal thos nas snying rje'i sems bskyed pa ni rgyu gsum pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mthong nas dga' ba khyad par can skyes te byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa 'di ni rgyu bzhi pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed cing*/ byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o// zhes gsungs so// sems bskyed pa de'ang dbye na dpe'i sgo nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma klu// rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes so// sa mtshams kyi dbye ba ni bzhi ste/

mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de yangs rnams la// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod// de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes so// ngo bos dbye na gnyis te/ brda dang chos nyid kyis thob pa gnyis so// zhes pas yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba dang*/ don dam pa chos nyid kyis thob pa'o// dang po la'ang smon 'jug gnyis te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// zhes so// don dam sems bskyed cho ga las mi skye bar yang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis byang chub sems 'grel las/ de ltar kun rdzob pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis goms par byas pa las gyur to zhes gsungs pas/ don dam sems bskyed bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ste/ des na de'i rang bzhin bshad pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung sogs rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma brtags shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed// snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni// 'bad de bsgom par bya ba nyid// ces pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ de'i 'grel par don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa de yang*/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mdo dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las gsungs pa'i lung dbu ma sgom rim las/ de ltar kun rdzob pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'bad par bya'o// don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba shin tu gsal ba don dam pa'i spyod yul/

dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba/ rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun bzhin du mi g.yo ba'o// de 'grub pa ni rtag tu gus pas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor goms par byas pa las gyur to// zhes gsungs pas/ don dam sems bskyed bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis sa dang po las 'byung bar bshad kyis/ cho ga las mi skye'o// pang kong las/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yang bsgoms byung la dgongs kyi cho ga las skye ba ma dgongs so// lar pang kong yang bod la gnam babs su byung ba yin gyis/ rgya gar las ma bsgyur bas mkhas pa rnams lung du byed pa'ang dka'o// sems bskyed ma byas pas mi dge ba'i las mang du byas na sems can dmyal bar skye ste/ de la grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad kyi tshe tshad ni/ mdzod las/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing*// til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur// zhes so// nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i tshe yang*/ de nyid las/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// zhes so// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par mi nus pa yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ mi gcig nyin re mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu 'jigs bsnun sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu yi// dper yang mi bzod rgyur yang mi mchi'o// zhes so// 'dod lha'i tshe ni/ mi rnams tshe lo lnga bcu la// 'dod pa dag gi lha rnams kyi// 'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o// zhes so// yi dwags kyi tshe ni/ zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya'o// zhes so// dud 'gro'i tshe ring ba ni/ dud 'gro mchog ring ba bskal par ro// thung ba ni nyin zhag gcig la sogs pa nges pa med do// sdug bsngal ni bkres pa dang skom pa la sogs pa du ma dang bcas pas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin no// dge ba'i las cung zad byas nas mtho ris su skyes na yang mi rnams 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa dang*/

mi 'dod pa spang gis mi spong ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas yid mi bde ba yin te/ ri dwags phal cher 'jigs pa ste// khyi rnams phal cher ltogs pa yin// mi rnams phal cher yid mi bde// zhes so// lha ma yin rang bzhin gyis lha'i dpal la sdang zhing sdug bsngal ba yin la/ lha rnams 'chi 'pho zhing ltung bas sdug bsngal ba yin pas/ 'dod khams kyi lha mi yang cung zad bde bar snang yang 'gyur bas sdug bsngal ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ bde 'gro yang dang yang 'ongs shing*// bde ba mang po spyad byas nas// shi nas ngan song sdug bsngal ni// yun ring mi bzad rnams su ltung*// zhes so// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang*// sa steng dag tu yang bran nyid du mchi// 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang*// slar yang ngan song nyid du ltung bar 'gyur// zhes so// gzugs dang gzugs med na yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang ldan pa yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ma spangs pa'i phyir ro// de'ang 'phags pa lhas/ bsam gtan nags mes yang dang yang du ni// nyon mongs tshang tshing bsregs par gyur mod kyang*// bdag lta'i rtsa ba brtan po ma spangs na// char gyis brlan bzhin mdun du rab tu skye// zhes so// des na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas gang du skyes kyang bde ba med la/ rang gcig pu zhi bde mya ngan las 'das pa thob kyang mchog ma yin te/ dpal phreng seng ge sgras zhus pa las/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa 'di dag ni/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis rgyu byas/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus blangs/ zag pa med pa'i las bsags/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye bas sdug bsngal ba lags so// zhes so// des na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sems bskyed dgos la/ de'ang yon dbul ba sngon du 'gro ste/

bskal pa bzang po las/ bde gshegs skye dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od zer la// gling bzhi dag ni dbul bar byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs grags byin 'dzam gling rgyal po'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i tog de la// gtsug lag khang ni bye ba byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po 'khor sgyur tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i 'od de la// bai ḍūrya yi khang bzangs phul nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// de bzhin gshegs pa snang mdzad bslang ba'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa'i rgyal po la// bshos dag bdag nyid btsongs te sbyar nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// de bzhin gshegs pa gya nom rgyal po yi// pho nya'i tshe na bde gshegs rgyal ba yi// bshes gnyen de la lan cig bskor byas nas// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs rlung shugs ltar gshegs dhin ta khye'u'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan grags pa de la ni// bsil yab dag gis lan cig g.yab pa byas nas kyang*// dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs don gyi blo gros lta mngon shes pa po// bram ze'i tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa lha mchog gi /zhabs la mgo bo dag gis phyag ni 'tshal nas kyang*// dang po nyid dang byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs 'od zer chen po lag bla'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu bsngags de la// skyu ru ra dag dbul ba byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs blo gros bzang po sman pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ro la// a ru ra dag dbul ba byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs 'od 'phro grong khyer brten pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas de la// rtswa yi sgron ma dag ni phul nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs bsod nams gzi brjid lci 'tshong tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa mkhas pas bsngags de la// lhung bzed bkru phyir lci ba'i gong bu phul// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge dag gis ni// de bzhin gshegs pa nga ro snyan de la// phyag dar khyod kyi lhan pa thal mo tsam// phul nas dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa na// de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la// 'jam gang zhig ni dbul ba byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// bde gshegs grags pa tha gar gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi sgron ma la// ras kyi kha tshar dag ni phul nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// zhes pa dang*/

de ltar sangs rgyas rnams la chung ngu yi// yon phul rnam par smin pa 'di dag yin// 'khor tshe de yi 'bras bu de 'dra na// mkhas pa su zhig byang chub sems mi bskyed// ces bya ba la sogs pa phan yon dang bcas pa du ma gsungs so// dbu ma pa'i sems bskyed gang zag so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang skye bar de nyid las/ rgyal ba phan bzhed grong dpon gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od de la// nyin gcig srog gcod sdom pa blangs nas kyang*// dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ sems can thams cad byang chub tu// sems bskyed bcug cing brtan byas na// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan pa'i// byang chub sems dang rtag ldan 'gyur// zhes so// sbyor ba la yan lag bdun pas dkon mchog mchod pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab dang sems dang ldan pa yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub don du// sangs rgyas rnams la gos sogs kyis// mngon sum mngon sum mngon par mchod// ces 'byung bas/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i dang por phyag ni/ spyod 'jug las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pas ni bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes so// yid kyis bstod pa yang bya ste/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces so// bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dag dang de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar// ljon shing me tog rgyas spras spud pa dang*// shin gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dag

/ngang pa shin tu sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su gzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la lags 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtse dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces pa dang*/ lus kyi mchod pa yang*/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus 'di rtag tu 'bul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// zhes so// blos sprul pa'i mchod pa yang*/ gos dang rgyan dang khrus dang phreng ba dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang rin po che'i gdugs dang rol mo la sogs pas mchod par bsam mo// bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// ces so// 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshul yang*/ dkon mchog ta la la las/ me tog phal cher me tog bla re dang*// me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye nas// me tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas te/ bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod// ces pa la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhin mchod par bya'o// de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ mchod pa rten dang gzhi dang ni// rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang*// rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang*// gnas kyi sgo nas rab tu bstan// zhes gsungs so// skyabs su 'gro ba yang*/

thun mong ma yin pa ni mchog yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ kun tu 'gro dang khas len rtogs pa zil gnon pa// dbye ba'i rang bzhin don dam bzhi yi khyad par gyis// theg pa mchog phyir dkon mchog skyabs rab song ba gang*// de ni skyabs su song ba rnams kyi mchog ces bya// zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa rnams kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya ste/ bslab btus las/ sdig pa bshags par bya ba dang*// bsod nams rjes su yi rang dang*// sangs rgyas bskul zhing gsol ba yang*// gzhan dang bdag gi spyi mthun yin// yongs su bsngo ba'ang de bzhin te// bye brag med par rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems can khams bzhin du// bsod nams dpag med rab tu skye// zhes so// rjes su yi rang ba ni/ bsod nams rgya cher spel ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad gzung rung*// rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min// zhes so// sbyor ba yan lag bdun pa byed par yang*/ sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ skye bo ma lus pa sdug bsngal las bskyab pa'i khur khyer bar spro ba des ni phyag bya ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba byas la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gsol ba gdab ste/ de'i tshig rjes su brjod do// zhes so// sems bskyed pa dngos gzhi'i dus su/ bsam pa sbyang ba yang*/ spyod 'jug las/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum bsags pa rnams// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phongs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub// thams cad gtang bar chab cig la// sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci dgar byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dam smod pa'am// brdeg btsog ci dgar byed la rag

/bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i sems byung ba// de nyid rtag tu de dag gi /don kun bsgrub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gzhan dag bdag la kha zer ram// gang dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub pa'i sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can kun gyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha' mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /ces bstan te/ de'i don ci rig par bshad do// dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi bkod pa las/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa yi// sngon gyi mtha' ma ji srid bar// de srid sems can phan don du// spyod pa dpag yas spyad par bya// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga 'dir// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// 'gro ba thams cad mgron gnyer te// dbul zhing phongs las grol bar bya// zhes so// smon 'jug dus gcig khas len pa yang*/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin bslab pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim bzhin du ni bslab par bgyi// zhes so// dngos gzhi'i cho ga 'di slob dpon klu sgrub gyis/

tshig lhug par gsungs pa de dang mthun par phyag len mdzad do// mjug gi phan yon gyis gzengs bstod pa'ang*/ de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis// rab dang byang chub sems bskyed nas// mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir// sems ni 'di ltar gzengs bstod do// zhes so// phan yon mdor bsdus pa ni/ dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung*// zhes so// rnyed dka' zhing phan yon che ba ni/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos// legs par rab tu brtags na rin che ba// 'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams// rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par gzung*// zhes so// 'bras bu zad mi shes pa la longs spyod pa ni/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu phyung nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes so// nges pa'i sdig pa zil gyis gnon pa ni/ sdig pa stobs chen mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten na yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten// zhes so// ma nges pa'i sdig pa drungs nas 'byin pa ni/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed// ces so// phan yon de dag lung dang sbyar zhing dpes bsngags pa ni/ de yi phan yon dpag tu med pa dag /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzang bshad// ces pa'o// byams pas ji lta bshad pa'i tshul cung zad cho ga'i yi ge las gsal lo// byams pa'i rnam thar las kyang*/ mar me gcig khang par bcug pa na/ lo stong du bsags pa'i mun pa thams cad sel zhing snang bar byed do// de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bskyed pa'i mar me gcig gis kyang sems can gyi khams kyi bsam pa'i thibs po dang*/

ma rig pa'i mun par zhugs pa na bskal ba brjod du med par bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i mun pa thams cad rnam par sel zhing ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed do// zhes so// yang dper na gang zhig nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i cod pan du 'dzin pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams la gnod pa thams cad kyi 'jigs pa med do// de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems dang snying rje'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i cod pan thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ngan song dang ngan 'gros gnod par bya ba'i 'jigs pa med do// zhes so// de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa de 'phags pa la ma yin nam snyam na/ so so'i skye bo la yang skye ba yin te/ 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa las/ 'jig tshogs kyi lta ba ri rab dang mnyam pa dral nas/ byang chub kyi sems skye zhing de las sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skye'o// zhes so// dkon mchog za ma tog las kyang*/ ka la piṅka'i phru gu sgo nga'i sbubs kyi nang na 'dug pa sgo nga ma brtol zhing sbubs nas ma phyung kyang ka la piṅka'i sgra nyid du 'byin to// de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs kyi nang na 'dug pa bdag tu lta ba ma brtol zhing khams gsum las ma phyung yang sangs rgyas kyi sgra stong pa nyid la sogs pa 'byin to zhes so/ skye dka' ba la ma yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ bslab btus las/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo drangs te/ g.yo byas te byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gsungs na dge ba sna 'ga' byas te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa lta ci smos/ zhes so// des na sems bskyed pa rin po che bdag la skyes pa yang rnyed par dka' ba thob pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ long bas phyag dar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ci zhig ltar stes nas// byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes// 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi// mi zad gter yang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i// sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no// srid lam 'khyam zhing dub pa yi// 'gro ba'i ngal so'i ljon shing yin// 'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las// sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag

/dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin// dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las// mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin// 'gro ba'i 'gron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing*// bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa las// 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas shing*// sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin// zhes gsungs so// sems bskyed pa yang dang yang du blangs na yang bsod nams 'phel ba yin te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa cig gis kyang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba grangs med dpag tu med pa la sogs par 'gyur na/ gang de ltar mang du byed pa lta ci smos// zhes so/ sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las 'byung ba'i don bslab btus las/ rgyal po la 'byung ba lnga ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa// phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod// dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa// gnyis par thub pas gsungs pa yin// tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang*// dur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang*// btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang*// rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang*// srog dang bral byed gsum pa yin// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang*// grong la sogs pa 'jig pa ste// rtsa ba'i ltung bar rgyal bas gsungs// blo sbyang ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang*// sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzlog pa dang*// so sor thar pa yongs spangs te// theg pa che la sbyor ba dang*// slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs// spong bar 'gyur ba min zhes 'dzin// pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang*// rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu yis gzhan smod dang*// bdag ni zab mo bzod pa'o zhes// log pa nyid ni smra ba dang*// dge slong chad pas gcod 'jug dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi sbyin byed dang*// nor brkus sbyin pa len byed dang*// zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang*// yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams// kha ton byed la sbyin pa rnams// de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste// sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu// rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying po'i// mdun du 'dug ste rgyun bshags bya// byang chub sems ni yongs 'dor dang*// chags dang ser sna mi bzad pas// slong la sbyin par mi byed dang*// bsgrims te dga' bar byed pa na// sems can la ni mi bzad par// khros pas sems can brdeg pa dang*// nyon mongs pa dang gzhan mthun pas// chos ltar bcos pas brjod pa'o// zhes so// nag po'i chos bzhi dang dkar po'i chos bzhi ni// dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/

nag po'i chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems nyams par 'gyur te/ de gang zhe na bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang*/ gzhan 'gyod pa med pa la 'gyod pa skyed pa dang*/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i sems can rnams la mi bsngags pa dang tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa 'byin pa dang*/ sgyu dang g.yos gzhan la nye bar spyod kyis lhag pa'i bsam pa ma yin pa'o// zhes so// chos bzhi dang ldan na skye ba thams cad du skyes ma thag tu byang chub kyi sems mngon du 'gyur zhing brjed par mi 'gyur te/ shes bzhin du brdzun mi smra ba dang*/ g.yo sgyu med par sems can thams cad kyi drung du lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston par 'du shes bskyed cing de dag gi yang dag pa'i bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod pa dang*/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa de dag nyi tshe ba'i theg par mi 'dod par bla na med pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa'o// zhes so// sems bskyed pa'i bslab pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ rgyal po la gdams pa las kyang*/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar khyed ni bya ba mang byed pa mang ste/ nyin mtshan du sbyin pa nas/ shes rab kyi bar la bslab par mi nus te/ de bas na rgyal po chen po khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dad pa dang don du gnyer ba dang*/ smon pa rtag par rgyun du dran par gyis la yid la bzung ste sgoms shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rangs nas kyang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phul cig phul nas kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar nyin gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sngos shig rgyal po chen po khyod de ltar byed na/

rgyal srid kyang byed la rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur la/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes so// 'di ni bslab bya'i rtsa ba yin pas nam yang spang bar mi bya'o// smon pa'i sems ma btang na nyes pa 'ga' zhig byung yang byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rdo rje rin po che ni chag kyang gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon cing*/ rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi 'dor la dbul ba yang rnam par zlog go /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che nan tan dang bral yang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad zil gyis gnon cing byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par zlog go /zhes so// nyams pa phyir bcos la ltung bshags dang yi ge brgya pa la sogs pas sdig pa sbyong ba nyid bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum dang*// phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems brten pas// ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya// zhes so// sems bskyed pa yang dang yang du len du 'jug pa la yang byang chub kyi sems mi 'dor ba'i rgyu yin te/ seng ges zhus pa'i mdo las/ grong dang grong khyer rnams su yang*// gang du gnas pa'i yul rnams su// byang chub la ni yang dag 'dzud// des ni sems 'dor mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ sems can thams cad thar bya'i phyir// byang chub don du sems btud pa// des ni chos rnams bsdus pa 'thob// des ni dag pa 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// chos 'dod pa'i don gyi phyir yul rnams su 'gro zhing yang bstan par bya ste/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/ zhi ba dang ni dul ba dang*// grol bas grong du zhugs nas kyang*// sems can gang dag chos tshol ba// de dag la bdag chos ston to// chos 'dod pa ni rtogs nas su// shin tu ring du'ang mchi bar bgyi// chos la dga' zhing mos rnyed nas// lus can rnams kyi don yang bgyi// zhes so// dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa ni mchog yin te/

dpal phreng seng ge sgras zhus pa las kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad smon lam chen po gcig gi nang na 'du ste/ 'di lta ste/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par ro// zhes so// blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos 'dzin pa// rgyal ba rnams kyis yongs su gzung bar 'gyur// lha dang klu dang mi'am ci rnams dang*// bsod nams ye shes kyis ni yongs su gzung*// zhes gsungs pas chos 'dzin pa la brtson par bya'o// byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa lung dang sbyar ba'o// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes slob pa// 'phags pa klu sgrub zhi ba lha// dze tā ri yi cho ga bzhin// theg pa chen po dbu ma yi// sems bskyed cho ga rab gsal bar// dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas// 'gro la brtse ba'i bsam pas bkod// tshul 'di kun mkhyen lung gis grub// 'jig rten mkhas pa rnams kyang bzhed// rigs pas brtags na skyon med pa// lam 'dis sems can kun grol shog /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa lung dang sbyar ba rdzogs so// bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
